decisions.question: Share reviewed values or independently calibrate each exact scorer identity?
decisions.recommendation: Exact content binding even if approved values coincide

decisions.question: Approve explicit rejection of unknown scorer identities?
Approve blocking missing or unverifiable provenance?
Define official errors, invalid rows and incomplete-run handling
decisions.recommendation: BLOCK; retain failed diagnostic evidence separately

decisions.question: Which metrics are hard gates and what reviewed finite values apply?
Approve exact frozen v1 rollback and isolated failure evidence?
Approve content-addressed policy/profile versioning and independent authorization?
decisions.recommendation: New hash and review on every rule/value change
